nodes.label: Redis-backed Undo Stack Pattern
nodes.rationale: Redis list used as a bounded undo stack (max 5 levels, 8-hour TTL) so staff can reverse accidental queue advances without a persistent audit trail or DB overhead.

nodes.label: Wait Time Estimation Algorithm
nodes.rationale: Uses weighted average of last 10 real service durations, multiplied by day-of-week and hour-of-day multipliers plus service-type modifiers, degrading gracefully to a fallback baseline when no historical data exists.

nodes.label: SignalR Real-time Queue Broadcast
nodes.rationale: After every mutation (advance, join, skip, undo) the service pushes QueueAdvanced and TicketUpdated events to branch-scoped SignalR groups so all connected clients update in real time without polling.
